# MSP Pure Water

> Whole-home water filtration, softening, well treatment and reverse osmosis for the Twin Cities. Transparent pricing, expert installation, free phone consultation. Serving Minneapolis, St. Paul, the Twin Cities metro and Greater Minnesota. Phone (952) 952-6206 (call or text), open 24 hours.

MSP Pure Water publishes every price, recommends equipment for the actual water problem, and handles consultations by phone (in-home presentations on request). Founder: Prince.

## Key facts

- Business: MSP Pure Water (service-area business, Minnesota)
- Website: https://msppurewaterco.com/
- Phone: (952) 952-6206

- Service area: 83 Twin Cities communities plus Greater Minnesota

- Google rating: 5.0 stars on Google

## Systems and installed prices (as of September 2026)

### City Water Systems
- [Whole Home Filtration & Softening System](https://msppurewaterco.com/systems/whole-home-softener/): $2,999 installed. Softens and filters every drop of water entering your home. One high-capacity media tank handles hardness, chlorine, chloramine, taste and odor, so every faucet, shower and appliance gets treated water.
- [Dual Tank Whole Home Filtration System](https://msppurewaterco.com/systems/dual-tank-city/): $3,999 installed. Gives the Jacobi catalytic carbon tank and the 10% crosslinked resin tank their own dedicated high-capacity vessels. Each media bed works at full strength, ideal for larger households and heavy water use.
- [Whole Home Complete Salt-Free Filtration System](https://msppurewaterco.com/systems/salt-free/): $4,499 installed. Whole-home carbon filtration plus salt-free scale conditioning. No salt bags, no brine discharge, no regeneration cycles. Keeps healthy minerals in your water while stopping them from sticking to pipes and appliances.

### Well Water Systems
- [Dual Tank Well Water Whole Home Filtration System](https://msppurewaterco.com/systems/dual-tank-well/): $4,499 installed. Treats the two biggest well-water problems, iron and hardness, chemical-free, and handles manganese along the way. Air-oxidation technology plus Katalox Light media stop staining while a dedicated 10% crosslinked resin tank softens your water.
- [Iron & Sulfur Treatment System](https://msppurewaterco.com/systems/iron-sulfur/): $5,999 installed. Our most powerful well-water solution, and the one we install for rotten-egg sulfur odor. Hydrogen peroxide oxidation destroys even severe iron and sulfur problems at the point of entry, then a dedicated Jacobi catalytic carbon tank and a 10% crosslinked resin tank finish the job.

### Drinking Water / Reverse Osmosis
- [HW800 AlkaPro Tankless Reverse Osmosis](https://msppurewaterco.com/systems/ro-tankless/): $999 installed. Purified, alkaline drinking water on demand, straight from a dedicated faucet at your sink. No storage tank, 70% less under-sink space, and water treated the moment you ask for it.
- [Traditional Tank Reverse Osmosis System](https://msppurewaterco.com/systems/ro-tank/): $799 installed. The proven multi-stage RO setup: purified water is produced continuously, stored in a pressurized steel tank, and delivered instantly the second you open the faucet.

### Optional Add-Ons
- [Pre-System Sediment Filter](https://msppurewaterco.com/systems/sediment-filter/): +$399 installed. The first line of defense on a well. Captures sand, silt, dirt and rust before they reach the resin, media and valves downstream.
- [Whole-Home UV Purifier](https://msppurewaterco.com/systems/uv-purifier/): +$899 installed. An additional disinfection barrier for well water. UV light inactivates microorganisms as water flows through a stainless chamber. It does not remove iron, sediment or dissolved chemicals, so it is installed after filtration.
